title: Find Books with No Available Copies
summary: SQL. library_books(book_id, title, author, genre, publication_year, total_copies) and borrowing_records(record_id, book_id, borrower_name, borrow_date, return_date). Find books whose unreturned borrows use up all copies.
tieRules: Unknown whether unreturned count must equal total_copies or may exceed it; how an unreturned record is identified (NULL return_date assumed).
questions: Does 'no available copies' mean count equals total_copies or greater-or-equal? Is an unreturned borrow return_date NULL? Output columns and order?
